description: A Seat Awaits helps authorized users manage event seating through ChatGPT. Paid subscribers receive planner tools by tier, including event creation, guest search, table creation, guest assignment, guest-list import, capacity checks, and event health reviews. Authorized operators and approved partners can retrieve aggregate marketing, revenue, traffic, signup, subscription, pricing, and partner payout metrics when granted.
